parts:
Hello LAVAAN members

Last chance to join our 2-day seminar Structural Equation Modeling in R livestreaming February 23–24 with Scott Colwell (University of Guelph and Enablytics). This seminar on Structural Equation Modeling in R offers a comprehensive exploration of SEM theory and practice, with a strong emphasis on the `lavaan` package. Participants will learn to specify, estimate, and interpret complex latent variable models, enhancing their ability to conduct advanced analyses within their existing `lavaan` workflows. These skills will enable researchers to build more robust, reproducible, and publishable studies, directly advancing their quantitative research endeavors.

Sign up today to secure your spot, and please share this opportunity with colleagues and students who might benefit!


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
Professor and Director
